text:
SSL::sessionticket
Description
This command returns the session ticket associated with the SSL flow.
Syntax
SSL
::
sessionticket
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
{
set
st
[
SSL
::
sessionticket
]
set
stlen
[
string
length
$st
]
log
local0.
"stlen $stlen"
log
local0.
"st $st"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE, CLIENTSSL_CLIENTHELLO, SERVERSSL,HANDSHAKE
